notes: December portal window: after the regular season your backups who plan to transfer say so, and you get one conversation each (2 hours) to keep them before January. Players on a deal or with a believable path to the field tend to stay. Conference Player of the Week for your guys after big Saturdays, with a Heisman bump. Live game on desktop gets a side panel: scoring by quarter, keys to the game from your plan, and your top performers and total yards at the final.
